market_question: Will Mirra Andreeva win the 2026 Women’s French Open?
reasoning: Mirra Andreeva is a promising young player, but winning a Grand Slam as an 18-19‑year‑old is historically very rare, especially on clay. Her current WTA level suggests she is unlikely to break through against seasoned top-10 opponents by 2026. The market’s 7.4% implied probability appears inflated by hype and far exceeds a realistic assessment of her chances.
evidence_points: Only a handful of teenagers have ever won the French Open in the Open Era, and none since Iga Świątek in 2020 at age 19.
Andreeva’s current ranking (outside top 30 in 2024) and performance in clay events do not yet match the level of consistent major contenders.
The depth of the women’s tour means several established stars (Świątek, Sabalenka, Gauff, etc.) remain heavy favourites for 2026.
sources_consulted: Current WTA rankings and recent match data
